what: The Mac app would not link: ONNX Runtime ships no Mac Catalyst library, so local ONNX picture generation cannot run inside the Mac app until a Mac build of it is shipped.
Start-up recovery could queue a job a second time while it was already waiting, so it ran twice; the runner now holds each job once.
The job runner was shut down twice by the service container and threw on the second time; shutting down is now done once.
A key saved under a different unlock key failed with a cryptic decryption error; it now says to enter the key again on Registry and providers.
An unreachable sign-in service showed a technical error with its address instead of the plain message.
The test host was marked not publishable, which broke the framework's boot step that publishes it before running.
The headless checks typed before the screen was interactive, so the typing was lost and the click waited on a disabled button.
Login and Setup required never carried their mockups' control names, so the framework's screen check could not map them; the names were added (pre-existing since phase 1).
discovery_why: found by the framework screen smoke run while building phase 3; no separate start mark was set

what: On Setup required the theme toggle overlapped the card at phone width; auth screens now start below the toggle (pre-existing since phase 1).
discovery_why: found by the framework screen smoke run while building phase 3; no separate start mark was set

what: On the test host the sign-in-again notice flashed and vanished: Login's start-up ran twice (pre-render, then live), and the first run used up the kept sign-in; it now runs once after the first live render.

Alerts on Login, Register, Forgot password and four admin screens showed an empty gap instead of their icon: three icon names (alert-triangle, alert-circle, check-circle) are not in the icon package; the screens now use its names.

The app frame and 18 phase-1 screens never carried their mockups' control names, so the screen checker graded every signed-in screen empty; the frame's names are added, the screens' own names wait for decision 11.
In light mode the green and amber status badges on eight screens used their tint colour for text, below 3:1 contrast; they now use darker text colours.
Reproduce on Projects answered not found (the screen sent a job id where a log id was expected) and a reproduced run lost its seed and project; it now takes either id and keeps both.
With personal mode off, Premium on Avatar studio was queued without checking the licence; the tier check was registered but never called, and the route now refuses with the upgrade message.

what: ComfyUI import: Run drew a made-up per-node progression ('Completed 5 of 5 nodes · live WebSocket preview') when the debug service could not be reached; it now says the service was not reached and shows no results

ComfyUI import: every model file a graph names is reported missing, because the dependency scan never asks ComfyUI what it holds; so a freshly imported real graph (one naming a checkpoint) never reads known-good and Save as model stays disabled. Needs a real ComfyUI to fix and prove.

Real Mac app: sign-in as test user 1 refused with 'A public API key call must name its device in the X-Device-Id header (1 to 200 characters)'; the app sent no device id. Fixed: a per-install id kept in the data folder is sent as X-Device-Id

Real Mac app: saving a key on Registry & providers failed with 'Couldn't store provider keys — check your admin session'; the real cause is the macOS Keychain refusing this unsigned build (MissingEntitlement), so no Keychain item is made and no key is kept. Fixed: the page now says the Keychain refu

Real Mac app: with Remember me ticked, sign-in as test user 1 failed outright ('Sign-in failed'): keeping the sign-in uses the Keychain, which refuses this unsigned build (MissingEntitlement). Fixed: the person is signed in for the session and told the sign-in could not be kept

Real Mac app: at the default 1.6 zoom the sidebar of every signed-in screen drew 1.6 windows tall; its footer (Sign out, surface switch) sat at y=2377 in a window ending at 1651, out of reach. Fixed: full-height utilities divide by --tr-zoom; the sidebar scrolls and pins its footer

Real Mac app: a job closed mid-run (stub, 10%) was marked Failed with 'TrStudio was closed while this job was running' on the next open, but the reason showed nowhere: Account's Recent jobs reads the generation log, which the start-up marking never wrote. Fixed: the marking writes the failed log row

Real Mac app @1280: the Render tier column covered the Script box; under the app's CSS zoom (about 1.27) neither the 1100px media query nor a container query folds the 300 + 1fr + 300 studio grid. Fixed: the studio row wraps by itself (flex-wrap), same wide layout; zoom tests at 1.25 and 1.6 in Chro

Real Mac app at 390 wide: choosing a screen from the folded menu left the menu sheet open over that screen (and over the page after widening back). Fixed: the sidebar closes the phone menu on every route change
AppManager sends its own role names (user 1 Admin, user 2 Manager); TrStudio read Admin as Operator and never knew Admin=Owner, Manager=Operator, User=Creator, so both test users landed wrong

A Mac Catalyst app can only use the data protection keychain, whose access group must be authorised by a Mac provisioning profile; the design never said so, so the unsigned app cannot keep keys or a kept sign-in

Video studio's Model box cuts a long seeded model name at 1280 px. Root cause: the box is a one-line native select in a 320 px column (240 px for text); names of 264-350 px were cut, and the sweep only checked that the screen rendered, never that the chosen text fit. Fixed: the chosen name is drawn
discovery_why: found by the owner or in production, not by a run
